Monthly discretionary information-risk factor-mimicking return. Each month, firms are independently ranked into quintiles using their most recent DiscAQ; the factor is average monthly excess return for the top two quintiles minus that for the bottom two. Fiscal-year-t DiscAQ scores are used to form portfolios for the 12-month period beginning in fiscal year t+1. Returns are winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles before portfolio formation. DiscAQ is the Eq. (6) residual, based on AQ from Eq. (5); AQ is the time-series standard deviation of Eq. (5) residuals over years t−4 through t.. Construct the return or annual score only after the event/industry support population is formed and the firm/date mapping is valid.

Monthly innate information-risk factor-mimicking return. Each month, firms are independently ranked into quintiles using their most recent InnateAQ; the factor is average monthly excess return for the top two quintiles minus that for the bottom two.
